_note: Repo interface parts for V18 gaps. Labels per brief. Unsliced - no slicer validation performed.

SF_XC_crossing_clamp_G10_2p0.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_XC_crossing_clamp_G10_2p0.notes: Crossrails over keels: plate above and below (x4 crossings = 8). Keels over the gear crossbar: plate above only (x2) - the crossbar runs through the belly skin; see the belly strap. M3 x 25 nylock. V18 left these joints undefined.

SF_XC_belly_strap_G10_2p0.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_XC_belly_strap_G10_2p0.notes: Same plate used OUTSIDE the belly under each keel/gear-crossbar crossing, through the skin cut-out the crossbar already needs; shim to the skin. M3 x 35.

SF_XC_drill_template_PLA.label: PROTOTYPE-READY
SF_XC_drill_template_PLA.notes: Tool only: scribe and centre-punch the G10 plates. Print flat, no supports.

SF_EDF_ear_bracket_lower.material: PA-CF (or PETG for the fit test)
SF_EDF_ear_bracket_lower.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_EDF_ear_bracket_lower.notes: C-bracket on each 8x8 EDF outrigger: lower flange + web + slotted ear tab. Stays 1 mm off the F4 skin. Fit test until the E7206 ear position is measured. Rotate 180 deg for the left side.

SF_EDF_ear_bracket_upper.material: PA-CF (or PETG for the fit test)
SF_EDF_ear_bracket_upper.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_EDF_ear_bracket_upper.notes: Upper flange; two M3 into the tapped web pull it onto the tube.

SF_FC_iso_pad_TPU.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_FC_iso_pad_TPU.notes: 52 x 32 x 3 isolation pad inside the V18 FC keep-out (54 x 34). Slotted: FC hole pattern unconfirmed.

SF_nose_steer_collar.label: EXPERIMENTAL
SF_nose_steer_collar.notes: Clamps the 4 mm nose leg (MEASURE); M3 set screw + nut; clevis holes at 10/13/16 mm. Print on end.
